summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Alexander Cornell du Houx, an American politician from Maine who also served as a U.S. Navy officer. It covers his enlistment in the Marines after high school, a deployment to Iraq, his election to the Maine House of Representatives in 2008 and 2012, his work with the Truman National Security Project on energy security, and his direct commission in the Navy reserves followed by a Middle East deployment.
one_line: Alexander Cornell du Houx is a Maine politician and U.S. Navy officer who served in Iraq and the Maine House of Representatives.
key_facts: Alexander Cornell du Houx was born on March 6, 1983.
Alexander Cornell du Houx is an American politician from Maine and an officer in the U.S. Navy.
Alexander Cornell du Houx joined the U.S. Marines out of high school.
Alexander Cornell du Houx was deployed to Iraq after joining the U.S. Marines.
Alexander Cornell du Houx was elected to the Maine House of Representatives in 2008.
Alexander Cornell du Houx was elected to the Maine House of Representatives again in 2012.
Alexander Cornell du Houx worked for the Truman National Security Project on energy security.
Alexander Cornell du Houx received a direct commission in the Navy reserves.
Alexander Cornell du Houx deployed to the Middle East after receiving a direct commission in the Navy reserves.
